atoms.text: Aoife now wants to take you around Belfast to end the tour. Will you go around Belfast with her?

instruction.text: Select Belfast on the map to return there.
Aoife wants to know if you recognise Belfast’s famous landmarks. Select the correct image.

hint.text: A landmark is a building or place that is easily recognisable. For example, it could be a huge tower, a statue or a mountain.
hint.label: Landmark

feedback.wrong: This is the Temple of Heaven in Beijing, China.
feedback.correct: Belfast City Hall is one of the most recognisable buildings in the city. This is where the city council does all their work for the people.

feedback.wrong: This is Sydney Harbour Bridge in Australia.
feedback.correct: Many different buildings have been known as Belfast Castle throughout history. The current building is a 19th century Victorian mansion.

wrong.text: This is Angkor Wat in Cambodia.
wrong.sound: this is angkor What in cambodia.

feedback.correct: Titanic Belfast is a museum where you can learn all about the famous story of the Titanic. The ship was built in Belfast and famously sunk on its first voyage!

atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f1Ie'>Which sea is Belfast connected to?</voice>

atoms.a: “What is the name of the place in Belfast that handles most of Northern Ireland’s sea trade?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f1Ie'>What is the name of the place in Belfast that handles most of Northern Ireland’s sea trade?</voice>

feedback.end: Belfast Harbour has existed since the early 17th century and is home to hundreds of businesses.
